text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $82k with modest gains, while Ethereum is essentially flat, suggesting cautious consolidation at current price levels rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index sits neutral at 53 but has declined 11 points over a week, indicating a gradual shift toward wariness despite the high trading volume of $30 trillion. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.4% reflects a slight defensive tilt toward the largest asset, though Solana's 1.2% outperformance hints that some risk appetite remains in the altcoin space.
